definitions: A Scotch whisky distillery located at the foot of Ben Nevis, near Fort William in the Scottish Highlands.
A producer of single malt Scotch whisky, known for its traditional production methods and range of expressions.
examples: Ben Nevis Distillery is one of Scotland's oldest licensed distilleries.
A tour of Ben Nevis Distillery offers insight into whisky making.
Ben Nevis Distillery produces both single malt and blended whiskies.
